### Editorial Plan: Jason Deck / Nice Jewish Runners (60 Seconds)

#### Story Beat 1: Identity & Athletic Foundation (0:00 – 0:14)
* **Goal & Mood:** Establish Jason's identity as a competitive Jewish athlete with an intimate, cinematic opening.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Open on Jason introducing himself and his club: "My name's Jason Deck, I live in Brooklyn, New York, and I run with Nice Jewish Runners." [[clip: P1071636-003 | 114.81s-119.07s]] Cut to him summarizing his pride: "And I think that's like the biggest thing, especially as somebody who takes athletics with pride and also Judaism." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 68.69s-77.13s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Begin the training progression in slow motion with Jason tying his running shoes on a park bench [[clip: P1071641 | 27.63s-41.22s]], transitioning to him warming up with hamstring stretches along the track [[clip: P1071643 | 0s-6.9s]] and a quad stretch by the railing [[clip: P1071645 | 8s-16.59s]]. Overlay warm light flares to establish an elevated, cinematic tone [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Audio:** A subtle, contemplative instrumental track enters softly underneath, building atmospheric warmth. On-screen graphic introduces his name and club affiliation: *Jason Deck – Nice Jewish Runners*.

---

#### Story Beat 2: Yearning for Community & Jewish Pride (0:14 – 0:30)
* **Goal & Mood:** Shift to an emotional, reflective tone tailored for Jewish American Heritage Month, emphasizing solidarity and shared heritage.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason reflects on searching for connection: "...the one thing that I did see was a strong Jewish connection, and that was something I was yearning for, especially after October 7th, and even during some of the marathons that I had run, I was writing stuff like Am Yisrael Chai on my shoes, and nice Jewish runners was literally a club dedicated to that phrase," [[clip: P1071636-003 | 337.91s-343.29s]] [[clip: P1071636-003 | 343.63s-361.39s]]. He adds the pride of racing openly: "I get the pleasure of running with a nice Jewish club. Wearing McGein David on my penny and competing in races." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 59.05s-68.43s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Slow-motion detail shots showcasing cultural identity: a close-up of Jason wearing his silver Mezuzah and Star of David necklace [[clip: P1071659 | 4s-10.64s]], a low side lunge stretch on the track surface [[clip: P1071646 | 0s-7.02s]], and a close-up of the NJR logo on his jacket [[clip: P1071652 | 7s-14s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** Slower cuts with deliberate focus on personal and cultural symbols, allowing the gravity of his words to resonate.

---

#### Story Beat 3: The Energy of the Run (0:30 – 0:45)
* **Goal & Mood:** Transition into high-energy, epic athletic motion, showing how team support elevates his performance.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason describes hearing support along the course: "But the one thing I do keep hearing is like NJR or like people showing in support. And for me, that's pretty special because I didn't have a team before coming to New York." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 292.04s-303.84s]] He notes the physical reaction: "You get that little tingle in the back of your skull and it's a really good feeling and it just makes you want to like do even better." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 320.62s-327.76s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Peak training flow in cinematic slow motion: tracking behind Jason as he jogs steadily on the track [[clip: P1071651 | 8.52s-14.42s]], an overhead aerial perspective tracking him running through New York streets [[clip: DJI_20260503181611_0001_D | 43s-75s]], a side-profile tracking shot in bright sun [[clip: P1071655 | 0s-4s]], and a powerful shot of Jason striding directly past the lens [[clip: P1071656 | 0.24s-8s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** The musical bed swells with driving rhythm, matching quicker rhythmic cuts of full-stride running.

---

#### Story Beat 4: An Open Invitation (0:45 – 1:00)
* **Goal & Mood:** Conclude with warmth, joy, and the creative brief's requirement that the run club is open to everyone regardless of pace.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason closes with an inviting smile: "Run with nice Jewish runners, and it's it's a great feeling to be around people that are willing to go pretty much any speed and Just have a conversation get some bopka and coffee after it's great" [[clip: P1071638 | 183.67s-196.71s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Visuals resolve on Jason breaking into a genuine, relaxed smile directly at the camera [[clip: P1071658 | 1s-6s]], layered with warm lens flare light leaks [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Graphics:** Music resolves warmly. Closing text slate displays: *Celebrating Jewish American Heritage Month* alongside the Nice Jewish Runners club logo and call-to-action. Fade to black.
